families.picture: a4..8, b1..a−1; crossed-out removal using takeArt. Count remaining, not crossed/initial group.
families.story: a5..9, b2..a−1, gives away to another actor. Distinguishes giving away from adding, and recipient count from amount left.

families.back: s0 5..10, k2..4, native line task0..12; landing s0−k; whyAt identifies wrong direction/start/no movement.
families.transfer: a7..10, b1..3 then c1..3 leave in stages; a−b−c remains nonnegative. Optional extension; no blind one-stage answer accepted if second removal is in question.

actualInventory.media: Read actual takeArt, signScene, lineHops; source ghosts are historical positions not remaining items. New core should label initial/removed/remaining explicitly.

actualInventory.registry: GOALS fallback through index; audit revision retained; cases four base families +transfer. No own family/coverage or SIMS overlay. COVERAGE omits actual back and uses stale global revision.
